name: XMLNode
description: Represents a single XML element applied to a document.
remarks: Each XML element that has been applied to a document is displayed as a node in a tree view control in the XML Structure task pane. Each node in the tree view is an instance of an XMLNode object. The hierarchy in the tree view indicates whether a node contains child nodes. Use the Item method of the XMLNodes collection to return an individual XMLNode object. Use the Validate method to verify that an XML element is valid according to the applied schemas and that any required child elements exist and are in the required order. Once you run the Validate method, use the ValidationStatus property to verify whether an element is valid, and use the ValidationErrorText property to display information about what the user needs to do to make the document conform to the XML schema rules. The following example validates each of the XML elements in the active document. If the element is found to be invalid against the schema, the example returns a message to the user explaining what the problem is.

properties.name: BaseName
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the name of the element without any prefix.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified XMLNode object.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the portion of a document that is contained in the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Returns or sets the text contained within the XML element. Read/write String.

properties.name: NamespaceURI
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) of the schema namespace for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: NextSibling
properties.description: Returns an XMLNode object that represents the next element in the document that is at the same level as the specified element.

properties.name: PreviousSibling
properties.description: Returns an XMLNode object that represents the previous element in the document that is at the same level as the specified element.

properties.name: ParentNode
properties.description: Returns an XMLNode object that represents the parent element of the specified element.

properties.name: FirstChild
properties.description: Returns a DiagramNode object that represents the first child node of a parent node. Read-only.

properties.name: LastChild
properties.description: Returns an XMLNode object that represents the last child node of an XML element.

properties.name: OwnerDocument
properties.description: Returns a Document object that represents the parent document of the specified XML element.

properties.name: NodeType
properties.description: Returns a WdXMLNodeType constant that represents the type of node.

properties.name: ChildNodes
properties.description: Returns an XMLNodes collection that represents the child elements of a specified element.

properties.name: Attributes
properties.description: Returns an XMLNodes collection that represents the attributes for the specified element.

properties.name: NodeValue
properties.description: Returns or sets a String that represents the value of an XML element. Read/write.

properties.name: HasChildNodes
properties.description: Returns a Boolean that represents whether an XML node has child nodes. Read-only.

properties.name: Level
properties.description: Returns a WdXMLNodeLevel constant that represents whether an XML element is part of a paragraph, is a paragraph, or is contained within a table cell or contains a table row. Read-only.

properties.name: ValidationStatus
properties.description: Returns a WdXMLValidationStatus constant that represents whether an element or attribute is valid according to the attached schema.

properties.name: ValidationErrorText
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the description for a validation error on an XMLNode object.

properties.name: PlaceholderText
properties.description: Sets or returns a String that represents the text displayed for an element that contains no text.

properties.name: WordOpenXML
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the XML for the node in the Microsoft Word Open XML format. Read-only.

methods.name: SelectSingleNode
methods.signature: SelectSingleNode(XPath As String, [PrefixMapping As String], [FastSearchSkippingTextNodes As Boolean]) As XMLNode
methods.description: Returns an XMLNode object that represents the first child element that matches the XPath parameter within the specified XML element. .

parameters.name: XPath
parameters.description: Specifies a valid XPath string. For more information on XPath, see the XPath reference documentation on the Microsoft Developer Network (MSDN) Web site.

parameters.name: PrefixMapping
parameters.description: Provides the prefix in the schema against which to perform the search. Use the PrefixMapping parameter if your XPath parameter uses names to search for elements.

parameters.name: FastSearchSkippingTextNodes
parameters.description: True skips all text nodes while searching for the specified node. False includes text nodes in the search. Default value is False.

methods.name: SelectNodes
methods.signature: SelectNodes(XPath As String, [PrefixMapping As String], [FastSearchSkippingTextNodes As Boolean]) As XMLNodes
methods.description: Returns an XMLNodes collection that represents all the child elements that match the XPath parameter, in the order in which they appear within the specified XML element.

parameters.name: XPath
parameters.description: Specifies a valid XPath string. For more information on XPath, see the XPath reference documentation on the Microsoft Developer Network (MSDN) Web site.

parameters.name: PrefixMapping
parameters.description: Provides the prefix in the schema against which to perform the search. Use the PrefixMapping parameter if your XPath parameter uses names to search for elements.

parameters.name: FastSearchSkippingTextNodes
parameters.description: True skips all text nodes while searching for the specified node. False includes text nodes in the search. Default value is False.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified XML element from an XML document.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies the specified XML element, excluding XML markup, to the Clipboard.

methods.name: RemoveChild
methods.description: Removes a child element from the specified element.

parameters.name: ChildElement
parameters.description: The child element to be removed.

methods.name: Cut
methods.description: Removes the specified XML element from the document and places it on the Clipboard.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates an individual XML element against the XML schemas that are attached to a document.

methods.name: SetValidationError
methods.signature: SetValidationError(Status As WdXMLValidationStatus, [ErrorText As Variant], [ClearedAutomatically As Boolean])
methods.description: Changes the validation error text displayed to a user for a specified node and forces Word to report a node as invalid.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Specifies whether to set the validation status error text (wdXMLValidationStatusCustom) or to clear the validation status error text (wdXMLValidationStatusOK).

parameters.name: ErrorText
parameters.description: The text displayed to the user. Leave blank when the Status parameter is set to wdXMLValidationStatusOK.

parameters.name: ClearedAutomatically
parameters.description: True automatically clears the error message as soon as the next validation event occurs on the specified node. False requires running the SetValidationError method with a Status parameter of wdXMLValidationStatusOK to clear the custom error text.
